title: Protective Effects of Oxyberberine Against Hyperuricemic Nephropathy: Mechanistic Insights From In Silico, In Vitro, and In Vivo Studies.
authors: Xu, Lieqiang; Yu, Qiuxia; Li, Xiang; Ai, Gaoxiang; Dou, Yaoxing; Lin, Guoshu; Su, Ziren; Xie, Jianhui; Xie, Qingfeng; Li, Yucui
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨小檗碱代谢物OBB对高尿酸血症肾病的保护作用，涉及分子对接但核心为药效与氧化应激通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Oxyberberine (OBB), a key metabolite of berberine (BBR), has exhibited enhanced pharmacological efficacy compared to BBR. Nonetheless, the potential of OBB in the treatment of hyperuricemic nephropathy (HN) warrants further investigation. Therefore, this investigation focused on elucidating the therapeutic efficacy and underlying mechanism of OBB in counteracting HN. An HN mouse model was established for in vivo study, while uric acid (UA)-stimulated human renal tubular epithelial cells (HK-2) were used for in vitro evaluation. Bioinformatics and molecular docking analyses were also employed. Bioinformatics analysis and molecular docking results underscored the critical involvement of the NLRP3 axis in mediating the protective effects of OBB against HN. In vivo, OBB treatment significantly reduced kidney weight and index, improved renal function, and mitigated abnormal histopathological alterations. Moreover, OBB lowered MDA, ROS, IL-1beta, IL-18, and TNF-alpha levels, along with enhanced SOD and CAT activities, both in vitro and in vivo. Mechanistically, OBB markedly lowered serum UA levels by increasing the expression of organic cation transporter 1/2 (OCT1/2) and organic cation/carnitine transporter 1/2 (OCTN1/2) at both transcriptional and translational levels. Additionally, OBB markedly reduced the expression of Keap1, TXNIP, NLRP3, ASC, Caspase-1, and GSDMD-N, while promoting Nrf2 nuclear translocation and enhancing the protein expression of HO-1, NQO1, CAT, SOD1, GCLC, and GPX4. Our results for the first time indicated that OBB treatment exerted a significant anti-HN effect. It reduced serum UA level by modulating the OCTs and OCTNs, a mechanism distinct from that of current first-line agents. Additionally, OBB alleviated renal damage through the modulation of the Keap1/Nrf2-NLRP3 axis.
abstract_zh: 氧小檗碱（OBB）作为小檗碱（BBR）的关键代谢物，已展现出比BBR更强的药理功效。然而，OBB在治疗高尿酸血症肾病（HN）中的潜力仍需进一步研究。因此，本研究旨在阐明OBB对抗HN的治疗效果及其潜在机制。体内研究建立了HN小鼠模型，而体外评估则使用尿酸（UA）刺激的人肾小管上皮细胞（HK-2）。同时采用了生物信息学和分子对接分析。生物信息学分析和分子对接结果强调了NLRP3轴在介导OBB对HN保护作用中的关键参与。在体内，OBB治疗显著降低了肾脏重量和指数，改善了肾功能，并减轻了异常的组织病理学改变。此外，OBB在体外和体内均降低了MDA、ROS、IL-1β、IL-18和TNF-α水平，同时增强了SOD和CAT活性。机制上，OBB通过增加有机阳离子转运体1/2（OCT1/2）和有机阳离子/肉碱转运体1/2（OCTN1/2）在转录和翻译水平的表达，显著降低了血清UA水平。此外，OBB显著降低了Keap1、TXNIP、NLRP3、ASC、Caspase-1和GSDMD-N的表达，同时促进Nrf2核转位，并增强HO-1、NQO1、CAT、SOD1、GCLC和GPX4的蛋白表达。我们的结果首次表明，OBB治疗发挥了显著的抗HN效应。它通过调节OCTs和OCTNs降低血清UA水平，这一机制不同于当前一线药物。此外，OBB通过调节Keap1/Nrf2-NLRP3轴减轻了肾脏损伤。
